name: ona-plotter-lint
description: Repo-root lint harness for OnaPlotter's wwwroot/js sources. Catches the TDZ / no-undef class of bug ESLint surfaces statically -- the kind that previously only failed at runtime in production (see fix(map): hoist editModeDeps before its first use, 2026-04). Not a build artefact: the Blazor build doesn't depend on it; CI runs npm run lint as a gate before the test step.
